title: Salmon salad
instructions: Prep all ingredients for Salmon salad: Can of salmon, Honey, Hot sauce, Onion or green onion.
Cook and assemble according to the doc method: Can of salmon Honey Hot sauce Onion or green onion Celery Cucumber Lemon Greek yogurt Dill Cilantro Cumin Oregano Feta cheese.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and acidity to taste and serve hot.
